items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I tell him I played two jobs with Duck on the side front, then I come with Jack Carey.

ctx.x: Okay. All right, all right. Well, who took Mutt's place? I want to get that straight. I'm the first one. Yeah, well Punch took Mutt's place, so that was 1919. Yeah, that's right. That's when Mutt Carey left. That's when I come in. And you had been playing with Duck, huh?

I played two jobs, I think, with Duck. That's two. What did you say, Mr. McHugh? Huh? What did you say? I tell him I played two jobs with Duck on the side front, then I come with Jack Carey. Yeah. It's just to stop up there and pick you up in races, you know what I mean? Yeah. And your faces coming in the back.
Well, I asked him who he played with right before he played with Jack.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: When we was with Jack Kerr. Oh man, we used to work.

ctx.x: You gotta come take your trink out. Yeah, you know it's water though.

Do you know some of them places where me and you and Jack Kerr worked? I can't remember any of them, did you? Where who? When we was with Jack Kerr. Oh man, we used to work. All those places, we used to work for Captain Powell. You remember him? Yeah. Out in front of town, out in front of town. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Turn down at the Benitez Hall. And then Kelly people, you know. All different halls. National Park? Yeah, National Park there and uh. Willow. Yeah. And uh. What about Highman Park? We used to get…
